messages:
Mina: Quick thread to lock scope for tomorrow's GA cut. Proposal: scoped GA = hosted API public + invited Dedicated pilot (no Private). Must-have gates: SLA doc + enforcement policy, canonical pricing table + pilot terms, runnable runbooks, alerting + dashboards, SDK samples, comms draft. Anything missing? :mag:
Ethan: +1 on scoped GA. Suggest we classify gates into MUST / MAY. MUST = SLA, pricing (with pilot caps), runbooks, basic alerts, smoke pass. MAY = extra SDK languages, expanded monitoring facets.
Carla: Legal note: SLA enforcement needs an explicit remediation clause (credits vs rollback). I prefer a rollback trigger for severity P0 incidents; credits are slow for customers. Will draft wording.
Noah: Ops: need concrete rollback playbook and a fallback routing plan to quantized model. I'll author commands and a supervised checklist. Example rollback command for ops: `redwoodctl rollout abort --service predictor --reason "p95_spike"`
Jess: Docs: I'll produce a one-page GA quickstart + pricing FAQ for pilots (overages, refunds, comms cadence). Also update SDK examples for streaming + graceful-fallback pseudocode.
Mina: On SLA enforcement — we must decide: do we promise automatic credits for downtime OR promise rapid rollback and remediation? Both are heavy. Thoughts?
Ethan: Prefer ops-first: promise rapid rollback/mitigation in the SLA, and an explicit credit policy as fallback only if mitigation fails >X hours. Keeps customer trust and avoids immediate financial exposure.
Carla: Legal okay with that as long as we define timelines and customer notification obligations. I'll add language: 4h remediation window, credit only after 12h unresolved outage.
Noah: For monitoring, we need machine-checkable definitions. Propose SLI definitions in docs: "available" = successful 2xx responses for gen endpoints sampled 1/1000. p95 calculation window = rolling 5m. Error rate measured over 5m windows.
Jess: I'll add SLI table to docs with exact queries (example for p95): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and a sample alert rule.
Ethan: Billing smoke plan: create synthetic tenant, drive 500 requests across tier sizes, validate invoice event and pilot cap enforcement (example check: `assert invoice.total <= pilot_cap`). ops-bot can schedule.
ops-bot: scheduled job `ga-billing-smoke-176888` for 2025-04-22T02:30:00Z. Will post result here.
Mina: Rollout strategy: start with 5% of hosted traffic, dedicated is invite-only. Need telemetry to verify token-cost variance and prompt regression. Also require eval suite pass on critical prompts before 5% -> 50%.
Noah: I'll add an automated gate: `eval-suite-run --suite critical_prompts` that must return score >= baseline. Example run command in runbook: `make eval SUITE=critical_prompts MIN_SCORE=0.92`
Carla: Legal needs the comms draft for pilot customer emails (data retention, T&Cs) before we notify customers. Jess, can you include a pre-approval note?
Jess: Will draft and ping legal. I'll add a short section in the pricing FAQ about pilot refunds and data residency questions.
Ethan: Small ops ask: do we have a documented cost-override for internal pilots? If not, we should add `pilot_cost_override` and call it out in pricing doc.
Noah: That exists as feature flag `pilot_override` in billing-service. I'll add a quick example in runbook for enabling in a tenant: `POST /admin/tenants/{id}/flags {pilot_override:true}`
ops-bot: ga-billing-smoke-176888 completed: PASS. invoice_event=1 expected=1; pilot_cap_enforced=true; logs: https://logs.redwood/smoke/176888
Mina: Great. Last logistics: timeline for PRs? SLA doc from Carla by 10:30 PT, pricing FAQ + pilot T&Cs from Jess by 11:00 PT, runbook + rollback commands from Noah by 11:30 PT, comms draft to legal by 12:00 PT. If all green, we cut to 5% at 14:00 PT.
Carla: SLA PR up at https://git.internal/sla/merge/55 — includes remediation windows and rollback-first policy.
Jess: Pricing FAQ + comms draft posted to docs/pricing/ga_pilot_faq.md.
Noah: Runbook PR in flight with rollback commands and eval gates.
Mina: I'll hold ship decision at 13:45 PT. If any MUST gate is missing at that time we mark amber and delay. Otherwise, green -> cut to 5%. coms-bot will send pilot invite after green.
comms-bot: draft pilot invite queued for review. To approve reply `approve-draft` in thread.
Ethan: Approve-draft (looks good from product).
Carla: Approved from legal after minor edit.
Mina: Thanks all. Summarizing owners: Carla (SLA/legal), Jess (docs/pricing/comms), Noah (runbooks/rollback/eval), Ethan (billing smoke + rollout knobs), Mina (release decision + shiproom). Will post final status in #all-hands at 13:50 PT.
